title: Ramsey number R(4,18), lower bound
statement: Find a two-colouring of the edges of K_n with no red K_4 and no blue K_18; it shows R(4,18) > n. The best known lower bound is R(4,18) >= 211, so a colouring of K_210 is known and one of K_211 or more would improve it.
submission: Text file: the n x n adjacency matrix of the red graph, one line of n characters 0/1 per vertex (1 red, 0 blue), symmetric with a zero diagonal; n <= 2048.

best_known.source: R(4,18) >= 211: Canli, github.com/arhancanli/quantavane-ramsey-records (K_210, one vertex added to our K_209, found 8 Nov 2026); before it 210 (Canli, K_209, 8 Nov 2026) and 209 [NaRT repository]; Small Ramsey Numbers rev. 18 printed 205; read 8 Nov 2026

provenance.keeper: Small Ramsey Numbers (S. Radziszowski), EJC Dynamic Survey DS1
provenance.revision: revision 18 (24 Apr 2026) and later sources named

score: n, the number of vertices of the colouring; it proves R(4,18) >= n + 1 (larger is better)
quantavane_note: our colouring is the best known (public in arhancanli/quantavane-ramsey-records)
